notes.title: Merry Christmas
notes.content:
Merry Christmas to everyone!!!
Unfortunately I forgot that it's that time again, so it's a day late...

As some of you know, I'm autistic, I have no friends, no family, I don't even dare to leave the house alone here in the city without getting panic attacks.

Next update
Unfortunately, the next update will take a while.

Some people think that I click the game together in some editor, but in reality I develop it alone in the Unreal Engine 5 (the logo in the game isn't there for fun), there's no clicking together ^^
All models are created by me, all materials are developed by me, the entire code was written by me.

Here is a video that shows how I create the new map, or rather, just the streets:
[previewyoutube=Dcjjh1D-yMg;full][/previewyoutube]

There are 70km of roads so far, but in the end it will definitely be 150, as I haven't even filled half of the map yet and the city is still missing...


The tuning menu will take a while, and if I ever manage to work on the van at all, it's only on the map.

Depressive phase
I'm pretty depressed at the moment, I was hoping to finally be successful with this game and then be able to live where I want to live...
I found a small house, right next to the forest, perfect for me, costs = €35,000, which is €35,000 more than I have.
But unfortunately the game isn't a success again, I have to live where the social welfare office wants me to live, I've been looking for a new apartment for 4 years since the office drove me out of my home, but I just can't find anything outside of cities...

As some of you may know, I'm autistic, I have no friends, family or wife, nothing that would be normal for others exists in my life.
In another month I'll be 38 and will continue to be patronized by the social services because I just can't get away from it.
I can't work normally, I can't go out and meet people or keep working on the same project.
This game always annoys me when I force myself to work on it, while I'm currently having no problems working on my survival, it's kind of weird, but that's how the life of an autistic person works...

Best wishes, don't give up, one day I'll be successful and finally be able to live the way I want.

notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.content:
Hello to all new drivers who found my game through the Steam Next Fest.

CURRENT CONTENT
The game will be released this year, the demo is still missing the save system, the employees and the passengers, which will be unlocked in the full version.
The employees will offer to deliver vehicles and receive special orders.

In addition, only 7 vehicles are drivable in the demo, if you want to see the rest, go either to the scrapyard, where all the created models have been placed (as well as some rims) or to the modding map, where all the vehicles I have set up can be selected and changed.NEW MAP
I am currently working on a larger map that offers more roads, which are mostly not as extreme as in the demo.

I actually wanted to release the game in July, but I haven't had time to add the rest of the gameplay in the last few weeks because I got feedback that you can't have such extreme roads in a transporter game, but everything has to be fairly straight. So I had to start a new map because the version 1 map was also pretty extreme (like Amalfi Coast)...

THANK YOU
I would be very happy if you put the game on your wish list so that you don't miss the release.

Thank you and have fun transporting goods ^^

MY OTHER GAMES

notes.title: The Demo is now available
notes.content:
Hello to everyone who has put it on their wish list so far and also to everyone new who is interested.

DEMO
The demo is available to everyone now until the game comes out in the summer (after Steam Next Fest).

The demo has a map of 16km² with 30km of roads.
7 of the currently over 60 land vehicles are playable.

VEHICLE-SETUP
In the next few days or weeks I will also make the vehicle setup menu/level freely accessible to everyone once I have finished testing all vehicles.

Here is a video about it:
[previewyoutube=KrXCLipLrCQ;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
